name: PDD-商品营销报表-商品级花费
description: 只读 PDD 推广后台「商品营销报表」：切到昨日，逐行读取商品维度的花费/交易额/投产比/曝光/点击等 40 列，直接铺成工作表（不依赖浏览器下载）。

steps.expression: return (function(){ var pick=function(e){return (e.innerText||e.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}; var clean=function(t){return String(t||'').replace(/商品 ?ID：.*$/,'').replace(/拼单价：.*$/,'').replace(/[|｜]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}; var heads=[]; document.querySelectorAll('table thead th').forEach(function(x){var v=pick(x); if(v) heads.push(v.slice(0,40));}); var y=new Date(Date.now()-86400000); var mm=(y.getMonth()+1); var dd=y.getDate(); var day=y.getFullYear()+'-'+(mm<10?'0'+mm:mm)+'-'+(dd<10?'0'+dd:dd); var rows=[]; var seen={}; document.querySelectorAll('[class*="anq-table-row"]').forEach(function(tr){ var cls=String(tr.className||''); if(cls.indexOf('anq-table-row-level')<0) return; var fix=''; var cells=[]; tr.querySelectorAll('[class*="anq-table-cell"]').forEach(function(c){ var cc=String(c.className||''); if(cc.indexOf('cell-fix-left')>=0){ if(!fix) fix=pick(c); return; } cells.push(pick(c).slice(0,40)); }); if(!cells.length) return; var m=/([0-9]{6,20})/.exec(fix); var id=m?m[1]:''; if(id&&seen[id]) return; if(id) seen[id]=1; var name=clean(fix.split('|')[0]||fix).slice(0,60); var p=/拼单价：([0-9.]+)/.exec(fix); rows.push([day,id,name,p?p[1]:''].concat(cells)); }); return JSON.stringify({columns:['日期','商品ID','商品名称','拼单价'].concat(heads), rows:rows.slice(0,200)}); })();
